xmp_writer

Struct XmpWriter 

Source 
pub struct XmpWriter<'a> { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

The main writer struct.

Use XmpWriter::new to create a new instance and get the resulting XMP metadata by calling XmpWriter::finish.
